name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-heart
title: Super Mario World Styled Heart
description:
A Super Mario World Styled Heart GFX to replace the super mushroom power-up / 1-UP Mushroom.

It uses Palette D, and replaces the Mushroom GFX. It's perfect for when you don't want Mario to keep on taking shrooms (or you have a general HP patch like Koopster's Sprite Health Bar or Demonsul's & KilloZapit's SMB2-Styled Health Bar).
